title: Actual finite scalar reduction and its representative normalization data
statement: Fix the finite-coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions] and positive levels $1\le m\le n$. Use the actual integral-reduced coefficient line and its signed powers and internal duals [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], the ordinary derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [def-weil-derived-tensor], and the scalar quotient of [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts]. Define their fixed-scalar coordinates by the published intrinsic module-sheaf equivalence. Define $Q$ as the left adjoint of exact scalar restriction, with its adjunction-normalized integer shift. A family of signed semilinear line maps is normalized when its zero map is the coefficient quotient, its first map sends $a\otimes i$ to $\bar a\otimes i$ for the actual ordinary integral tensor, positive powers commute with the specified ordered pure tensors, and negative powers commute with dual evaluation. Normalize a derived line comparison by requiring its adjoint on degree-zero single complexes to be that semilinear map, using the canonical single-complex comparison of exact restriction. For cochains use the native scalar-first binary comparison $b\otimes(x\otimes y)\mapsto(b\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y)$. Use the recorded coefficient comparisons [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons] and their scalar-unit-normalized fixed-scalar realization [def-sp-finite-scalar-realization-presentations] [def-sp-coefficient-scalar-representatives].
